reason: A CLI and agent skill for creating, parsing, checking, formatting, revising, and auditing Chinese official DOCX documents according to GB/T 9704, with Markdown conversion and template support.

summaries.zh: 面向中文公文的文档处理工具，可按 GB/T 9704 规则生成、解析、检查、修复和审校 DOCX 文件。
summaries.en: A document-processing tool for creating, parsing, checking, formatting, revising, and auditing Chinese official DOCX files under GB/T 9704 rules.

capabilities: Checks and repairs document formatting against GB/T 9704 rules
Generates DOCX templates and converts Markdown or structured models to DOCX
Applies tracked revisions, comments, headers, footers, and page numbers to documents
Manages formatting rules and learned document styles
May perform external version checks and fact-verification workflows when configured
